name: loom
description: A docs & context harness for Claude Code and Codex — four skills plus a bash/awk linter and slicer that keep a repo's documentation lean, routed, and useful to agents.

interface.shortDescription: Docs & context harness for lean, routed docs
interface.longDescription: loom bundles documentation-focused skills plus a SessionStart context slicer so agents enter a repository with targeted bearings instead of stale or bloated docs.
